objective: Después de corregir y certificar la precedencia Runtime, ejecutar el backfill REAL del detalle histórico de CIENFUEGOS para 2026-10-15. La tabla base y Runtime ya concilian en $203625.00, 55 tickets y 144 PAX. Poblar Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto y certificar que el detalle conciliado ya coincide con Runtime/base. No tocar sincronizadores protegidos ni Producción.

queries.name: cienfuegos_oct15_detail_final_parity
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT numero_ticket,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15' GROUP BY numero_ticket), ds AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle,CAST(SUM(venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_detalle,SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM d), r AS (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,tickets_total AS runtime_tickets,pax_total AS runtime_pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15') SELECT ds.tickets_detalle,ds.ventas_detalle,ds.pax_detalle,r.runtime_tickets,r.runtime_ventas,r.runtime_pax,CAST(ds.ventas_detalle-r.runtime_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_ventas,ds.tickets_detalle-r.runtime_tickets AS delta_tickets,ds.pax_detalle-r.runtime_pax AS delta_pax FROM ds CROSS JOIN r
